alice.tucson.api
Class TupleCentreId

java.lang.Object
  alice.respect.TupleCentreId
      alice.tucson.api.TupleCentreId

public class TupleCentreId
extends alice.respect.TupleCentreId

Defines the Tuple Centre identifier for TuCSoN logic tuple centres. Tuple Centre identifier is a logic ground term The id can include also the identifier of the TuCSoN node where the tuple centre is located: in this case the logic term is in the form tupleCentreName @ tucsonNodeIdentifier The template is: term @ term So in the case of Internet Address used as TuCSoN nodes the node identifier must be enclosed in apices; for instance: '137.204.191.189' or 'lia.deis.unibo.it'
